name: Station charger AC-failure indication
aliases: substations Station battery and charger distribution
summary: Reports loss of the assigned charger input supply while distinguishing the available battery path.
description: Reports loss of the assigned charger input supply while distinguishing the available battery path. A station battery system supplies protection, control and other assigned DC loads through a documented charger and distribution arrangement. Charger output, battery contribution and load distribution are related but separately monitored paths.

In a substation control building, the battery can support breaker trip circuits while the charger AC supply is unavailable. Supervision must identify whether the charger, battery or a downstream feeder is affected. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Charger AC input health” at the input and “Charger AC-failure alarm” at the output. Battery support may remain available.
